sources.title: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-2.6B Beats 9B Models Running Entirely on Your Phone ...
sources.snippet: New release: LFM2.5-2.6B is a 2.6B parameter agentic model designed to run fully on-device with no cloud dependency. Benchmark performance: Beats Qwen3.5-9B on ToolSandbox (77.83 vs 76.44) and all instruction-following benchmarks despite being 4x smaller. Speed: 220 tok/s on Apple M5 Max, 113 tok/s on AMD Ryzen CPU, 30 tok/s on a phone, all under 2.5 GB memory. Architecture: Hybrid LFM2 design ...
